body: Two of these block the merge; the retry loop is worth fixing in the same PR.

comments.body: A coupon larger than the subtotal makes `subtotal` negative, so `invoice_total` returns a credit that gets charged as a refund. Clamp it: `subtotal = max(subtotal - coupon["amount"], 0)`.
`price` and `qty` arrive as floats from JSON, but `TAX_RATE` is a `Decimal`, so `subtotal * TAX_RATE` raises `TypeError`. Convert with `Decimal(str(price))` at the boundary.
After the last attempt this returns `None`, which reads as a successful empty reply. Re-raise the last `ConnectionError` so the caller can tell a lost payload from a delivered one.
